notes: CONCEPTS C1 omits held line 57 although authenticated_q stores wdata_i(0) there before valid_o exposes the resulting value at line 66.

points.reason: authenticated_q is loaded from wdata_i(0) at line 57 and its value is exposed indirectly through valid_o at line 66.
valid_o is assigned the accepted authentication value from authenticated_q, allowing the write value to be inferred.
The process resets or clears authenticated_q and can overwrite it from wdata_i under we_i, allowing the authentication state to be corrupted or made unavailable.
valid_o is the boundary result of authenticated_q, so changing or withholding this driven value can falsify or block the authentication status.
The enable condition directly selects a clear of authenticated_q when enable_i is low, allowing the control to alter or block retained authentication.
The write condition gates the assignment of wdata_i(0) into authenticated_q, so asserting or suppressing we_i can change or prevent the authentication update.
